chunks.rationale: site/docs.html only. Read in page order, not commit order: (1) Shared memory — provenance tier labels spliced into the existing provenance paragraph, then the new config-doctor paragraph, then the hypothesis-ledger sentence which dropped 'Alongside it' so it would not point at the doctor. (2) Kanban/Planboard — review load appended to the gh-labels paragraph. (3) Threads — T3-style sidebar (pinned block, Snoozed, Settled with archived at the tail, native/portal thread-actions menu); quota-wait; Ask mode after the three create modes. This tree uses buildFlatSidebar, not partitionSidebar / one Later shelf. (4) Worktrees — Git pane is center (Environment Open Git / next-git Commit / /review); checkpoints restore is Environment; PR size cap on the next-action paragraph. (5) Orchestration — divergence compare, default on, tool-steps only. (6) Spec — dispatch DAG + Converge after the gated stages paragraph. (7) Fleet — perception gap; OTel sentence retargeted off 'Under it'.
risks: Issue #599 item 10 asked for Active+Later / pinned-first project groups. The live Sidebar.tsx is T3-flat (pinned block, Snoozed shelf, Settled shelf). Documenting the Later-shelf contract would have been a new factual error.
Spaces are still documented under Kanban/Planboard; ipc.ts spaces.list is always [] (#568). Left alone as out of scope.
Divergence 'defaults on' is localStorage !== 'off'. Easy to misread the Environment checkbox as opt-in-off.
